<translate>
<!--T:5-->
'''Evil Buu''' is one of the forms of [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Buu|Majin Buu]] that you fight in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]], and a possible contender in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]]. His '''Candy Beam''' turns you into candy, and he backs it up with Gum Punches, pink ki and the strongest Zanzoken.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:6-->

<!--T:7-->
Evil Buu is one of the Buu Saga fighters that can be drawn as a contender in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]]. Like every contender, he is drawn at random and revealed once everybody accepts the rules. He counts as a different fighter from the other forms of Majin Buu, so he can share a bracket with them.

<!--T:8-->
His stats come from the [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments#Configuration|contender entry]] that drew him: by default between 238,000 and 612,500 health, 9,900 to 25,800 melee damage and 8,840 to 23,460 ki damage, on the Smart AI tier for the four weakest entries and Elite for the other five. He gets 8% stronger for every round already played.

<!--T:9-->
Hover him on the tournament screen to see his stats; with Bulma's '''Threat Database''' scan data you also see his ki attacks and combos.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
Evil Buu is a little bigger than a normal fighter. He flies, uses the strongest [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|Zanzoken]] (6 after-image hops), can teleport next to you and can hop back when you hit him.

<!--T:12-->
* '''Candy Beam:''' a beam that turns you into candy for a few seconds, leaving you helpless (the '''Candy''' effect, see [[Special:MyLanguage/Effects|Effects]]).
* '''Ki Volley''' and '''Ki Blast:''' pink ki blasts.
* '''Gum Punch:''' he appears in front of you and sends you flying with one heavy punch.
* '''Melee Combo:''' he blinks around you for three hits; the last one knocks you away.
* '''Aerial Combo:''' he knocks you into the air, appears above you and slams you back down.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:13-->

<!--T:14-->
[[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 20, '''Evil Buu''', has you defeat him in Earth's plains.
</translate>
